where: A homestead in the City of West Palm Beach (which runs its own library and fire department, so the county library and fire-rescue districts aren’t on this bill).

exemptions.note: Florida’s 2026 homestead exemption: $25,000 off school taxes and $51,411 off all others (Florida Dept. of Revenue).

split_note: Each government’s share is one slice, except voted debt levies, which are shown as debt.
rollback_note: The rolled-back rate is the “no-raise” rate: the rate that would bring each government the same property tax as last year from the same properties. Florida’s Truth in Millage law makes each one publish it; if the adopted rate is higher, its ad must call it a tax increase.
hearing: Rates are set at two September hearings. Palm Beach County adopted 4.5000 operating and 0.0210 debt on September 15, 2026; the other rates shown are the July proposals (the ceilings).
limits: Except for the county, rates are the July proposed (not-to-exceed) rates; final September rates may be the same or lower.
Amendment 3 on the November 3 ballot would change Florida’s homestead exemptions (facts only on this site).
